name: 76148 · Watauga, TX
findings: ZIP 76148 (Watauga) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76148 (Watauga) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 76148 (Watauga) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 47% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.
